1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Gititi”. Ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

2.text: Muririmbishirize Imana ijwi rirenga ni yo mbaraga zacu,Muvugirize Imana ya Yakobo impundu.

3.text: Muririmbe indirimbo muvuze ishako,Mucurange inanga nziza na nebelu.

4.text: Muvuze impanda ukwezi kubonetse,Kandi ukwezi kuzoye ku munsi wacu mukuru.

5.text: Kuko iryo ari ryo tegeko ryategetswe Abisirayeli,Itegeko ry'Imana ya Yakobo.

6.text: Yarikomereje mu Bayosefu kuba iryo guhamya,Ubwo yasohokaga igahagurukira igihugu cya Egiputa.Ni ho numvise amagambo y'Uwo ntari nzi ati

7.text: “Nakuye urutugu rwe ku mutwaro,Amaboko ye yakuweho uburetwa bw'igitebo.

8.text: Ubwo wari mu mubabaro waratatse, ndagukiza,Nagushubije ndi mu bwihisho bw'inkuba,Nakugeragereje ku mazi y'i Meriba.Sela.

9.text: Bwoko bwanjye, umva ndaguhamiriza,Wa bwoko bw'Abisirayeli we, iyaba unyumvira.

10.text: Muri wowe ntihakabe ikigirwamana cy'abanyamahanga,Kandi ntukagire ikigirwamana cy'abanyamahanga usenga.

11.text: Ni jye Uwiteka Imana yawe wagukuye mu gihugu cya Egiputa,Asama cyane nduzuza akanwa kawe.

12.text: “Maze ubwoko bwanjye ntibwumviye ijwi ryanjye,Abisirayeli banga kunyitondera.

13.text: Nanjye ndabareka ngo bakurikize kunangirwa kw'imitima yabo,Bagendere mu migambi yabo.

14.text: Iyaba ubwoko bwanjye bunyumvira,Iyaba Abisirayeli bagendera mu nzira zanjye,

15.text: Natsinda ababisha babo vuba,Nahīndurira ukuboko kwanjye ku babarwanya.

16.text: Abanzi b'Uwiteka bakamugomokera bakamushyeshya,Ariko ba bandi bakarama iteka.

17.text: Yabagaburira amasaka ahunze,Kandi naguhaza ubuhura bwo mu mbigo.”
